authorBio: Charles DeFelice is a Phoenix-based entrepreneur and AI automation specialist with over a decade of hands-on experience running and scaling local service businesses across Arizona. He founded Viking Marketing after seeing firsthand how many good businesses lose customers simply because no one picked up the phone. Charles is an early-access partner of CloseBot and a recognized expert in AI-powered lead management, having run campaigns that engaged over 2,000 contacts a day.

By Charles DeFelice, Founder of Viking Marketing | Published July 28, 2026

Viking Marketing's July 2026 announcement, naming the company a top AI appointment setter and all in one CRM for local service businesses, was carried by more than 40 national and local news outlets, includin

In short: In July 2026, Viking Marketing, the Chandler, Arizona AI appointment setter and all in one CRM built for local service businesses, announced its 2026 platform milestone. The announcement was distributed through AB Newswire and carried by more than 40 news outlets across the United States and Canada. Coverage included national wire services such as AP News and USA Today, financial publications including Barchart, StreetInsider, and International Business Times, and dozens of local newspapers and television broadcast affiliates. You can read the full announcement on AB Newswire.

We have news worth sharing.

In July 2026, our announcement naming Viking Marketing a top AI appointment setter and all in one CRM for local service businesses was carried across more than 40 news outlets. That included major wire services, financial publications, daily newspapers, and local television affiliates.

I started this company in Chandler, Arizona to solve one problem for local service businesses. So seeing our name reach outlets from AP News to USA Today, plus newspapers and TV affiliates in dozens of cities, means something to our team.

Below is the full picture. Where the announcement appeared, what it said, and what it actually means for the businesses that use us every day.

What the Announcement Covered

The announcement introduced Viking Marketing as a top AI appointment setter and all in one CRM built specifically for local service businesses across the United States.

It covered the core of what our platform does. We respond to inbound customer inquiries within 60 seconds across text message, website chat, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and email. When a phone call goes unanswered, our system texts that caller back in about 60 seconds and moves the conversation into the inbox. From there, our AI qualifies the lead and books the appointment straight to the business calendar.

The coverage also noted our 5.0 rating across 21 verified customer reviews, our 48 hour setup handled by our Chandler based team, and the range of industries we serve.

You can read the complete announcement on AB Newswire, which is the original source.

Why This Milestone Matters for Local Service Businesses

I built Viking Marketing in Chandler, Arizona to fix one costly problem. Local service businesses lose customers because nobody answers fast enough.

Think about how it really happens. A homeowner calls three HVAC companies. One picks up. That company gets the job. The other two lost it on response time alone. Not on price. Not on quality of work. They just answered second and third.

Our AI appointment setter answers every inquiry in under a minute, day or night, without the business hiring another person.

Here is what I said in the announcement:

"Local service businesses lose customers every day for one reason. Nobody answered fast enough. We built Viking Marketing in Chandler to solve that for local businesses first. Now businesses across the country use it to respond to every inquiry in under a minute."

Seeing that message carried by news outlets nationwide tells me something simple. More owners are realizing they do not have to keep losing leads to slow response times.

What Viking Marketing Actually Does

If you are finding us for the first time through this coverage, here is the plain version.

Viking Marketing puts the tools a local service business needs into one system. We answer inbound inquiries within 60 seconds across every channel your customers already use. We qualify each lead using your rules, not generic ones. Then we book the appointment straight to your calendar.

When a conversation needs real human judgment, it goes to your staff with the full history attached. We do not force a customer through a bot when a person should step in.

Beyond lead response, the platform includes a unified all in one inbox, missed call text back, automated review requests, database reactivation campaigns, and invoicing with text based payments, plus full customer tracking.

Plans start at $297 per month. No long term contracts. No setup fees. Most businesses are fully live within 48 hours. You can see current plans on our pricing page, or estimate what missed calls are costing you with our missed call ROI calculator.

Which Industries We Serve

Local service businesses lose leads in different ways, so we build the setup around each industry. Here is where we work most:

  • Dental practices. New patient bookings, recalls, and review requests handled automatically. See our AI appointment setter for dentists.

  • Healthcare and medical intake. Fast response with HIPAA handling and a signed Business Associate Agreement. See AI appointment setter for healthcare.

  • Insurance agencies. Quote follow up before the lead calls three other agents. See AI appointment setter for insurance.

  • Solar companies. High cost leads answered instantly, plus reactivation of old quotes. See AI appointment setter for solar leads.

  • Real estate agents. Reply in under a minute when speed decides the commission. See AI appointment setter for real estate.

  • Mortgage teams. Qualify and book rate conversations before the lead goes cold. See AI appointment setter for mortgage.

  • Marketing agencies. Run lead response for many clients from one system. See AI appointment setter for agencies.

  • B2B sales teams. Qualify inbound and revive a stale pipeline. See AI appointment setter for B2B sales.

  • SaaS teams. Book demos from trials and inbound without a human touching the first reply. See AI appointment setter for SaaS.

  • Home services and trades. HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and roofing teams that cannot answer the phone while on a job.

  • Med spas, salons, and gyms. Consults, class signups, reminders, and rebooking, handled without front desk staff.

Not sure where your business fits? Book a 15 minute call and we will tell you honestly if we are a fit.
